en.debrief.positionMapHint: Price against quality, relative to the class average (1.00). Bubble area is market share. Being between the two clusters is the place Porter warns about.
en.debrief.positionFlatQuality: Nobody has bought quality this round, so the vertical axis is brand instead — the other half of the position. It returns to quality as soon as anyone differs.
en.debrief.unserved: Demand the class could not serve
en.debrief.positionMapQuadrants: Quadrants: cheap suppliers (bottom left) · premium and differentiated (bottom right) · stuck in the middle (top left) · priced above what they offer (top right).

zh.debrief.positionMapHint: 以全班平均为 1.00 的价格—质量位置；气泡面积代表市场份额。卡在两类之间的位置，正是波特提醒要避免的。
zh.debrief.positionFlatQuality: 本轮没有任何公司购买质量，纵轴改用品牌——定位的另一半。一旦各公司质量出现差异，纵轴会切回质量。
zh.debrief.positionMapQuadrants: 四个象限：廉价供应商（左下）· 高端差异化（右下）· 卡在中间（左上）· 价高于质（右上）。
